anti_rescue_rule: After first external scoring run: no target-crate substitution, upstream commit change, decision semantic change, dependency-kind rule change, intervention-count change, baseline weakening, threshold change, or missing-edge scoring change.
ground_truth_oracle: Separately implemented from propagation. Recompute each decision's standing from frozen cargo dependency-kind closures, frozen build result, and the injected component signal. It does not import graph traversal code.
hypothesis_h1: Decision-specific evidence bindings will preserve affected-decision recall while reducing false reopening of orthogonal decisions relative to artifact-level component joins on blind post-freeze component invalidations.

intervention_selector.absent_definition: external component appears in full upstream cargo metadata but in none of the six target closures
intervention_selector.missing_edge_rule: Pair with a selected affected component, remove one actual component-to-security evidence edge after t0 freeze, and mark that exact target/kind graph segment INCOMPLETE. Missingness is known; it is never silently treated as independence.
intervention_selector.shared_definition: external component appears in union dependency closure of at least 2 frozen target crates
intervention_selector.single_definition: external component appears in union dependency closure of exactly 1 frozen target crate

metrics.bootstrap_quantity: artifact_component_join false_reopen_rate minus OLP false_reopen_rate, trial-cluster bootstrap
metrics.decision_recall: TP/(TP+FN), REOPEN counts positive; UNDETERMINED is not a true positive
metrics.silent_false_retain_rate_missing_edge: Affected decisions output RETAIN / affected decisions in known-missing-edge trials. UNDETERMINED is safe-unresolved, not RETAIN.
metrics.unresolved_rate_missing_edge: UNDETERMINED outputs / all decision outputs in known-missing-edge trials

missing_edge_population: Known missing-edge trials scored separately for silent false-retain safety.
null_h0: Artifact-level component joins achieve materially equivalent decision precision/false-reopen performance at equivalent recall.
primary_population: Complete-graph shared, single-target, and absent-control trials only.
primary_question: After t0 decisions and evidence bindings are frozen on a real external software workspace, can decision-specific evidence propagation localize a later blind component invalidation with materially less unnecessary revocation than artifact-level component joins while avoiding silent false retain under known graph damage?
stop_rule: If CAPABILITY_PARITY or SAFETY_FAILURE, do not progress this line to EWS/MIN/FAST on the basis of PSD-001. If positive, only selective localization/containment is earned.

strategies.artifact_component_join: Given the same invalidated component and exact target artifact component membership, REOPEN all five active decisions for every target whose union closure contains the component.
strategies.decision_closure_index: Diagnostic equivalence baseline: precomputed decision-specific component sets derived from the same t0 metadata, no graph traversal. Expected to match complete-graph OpenLine outcomes; parity here limits algorithmic novelty claims.
strategies.headline_only: RETAIN everything at t1; no containment before later consequence.
strategies.openline_evidence_graph: REOPEN when invalidated component reaches a decision through frozen evidence edges; UNDETERMINED when a known-incomplete affected target/kind segment could hide a path; otherwise RETAIN.
strategies.repo_scope_join: If invalidated component is present in any selected target, REOPEN all 30 decisions.

decision_semantics.build_acceptance: The frozen target set passes cargo check at the pinned upstream commit.
decision_semantics.build_security_acceptance: No externally invalidated component exists in the target's frozen build-root dependency closure.
decision_semantics.promotion_permission: Runtime-security, build-security, and build-acceptance decisions retain standing. Test-security is informative but not promotion-critical.
decision_semantics.runtime_security_acceptance: No externally invalidated component exists in the target's frozen normal-root dependency closure.
decision_semantics.test_security_acceptance: No externally invalidated component exists in the target's frozen dev-root dependency closure.

t0.receipt_binding: deterministic SHA-256 canonical JSON receipts; signature layer explicitly out of scope

title: Prospective Selective Standing Propagation
verdict_rule: SAFETY_FAILURE if known missing-edge trials silently RETAIN any affected decision. DATA_INSUFFICIENT if source/data gates fail. SELECTIVE_LOCALIZATION_ADVANTAGE only if all positive criteria pass and artifact_component_join precision is < 0.90 of OpenLine precision. Otherwise CAPABILITY_PARITY. Exact decision_closure_index parity is expected and explicitly limits the result to the value of decision-specific binding versus artifact-level joining.
